rationale: C19 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both are presidential letters appointing a named individual as Special Assistant to the President for international or foreign-economic work, defining the role through advice and assistance concerning programs spanning multiple departments and agencies, using the formula “I shall look to you,” and providing participation in high-level coordinating bodies. The child substantially abbreviates and adapts C19’s appointment-and-coordination machinery to Rockefeller’s broader mission of international understanding. C21 is also a strong structural analogue, while C24 shares the addressee and substantive international-development setting but not the same appointment structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby appoint you as Special Assistant to the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Effective immediately I am designating you as Special Assistant to the President
shared_material.explanation: The central operative act is expressed in closely parallel appointment language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I shall look to you for advice and assistance in the development of increased understanding and cooperation among all peoples.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to assist and advise me in accomplishing an orderly development of foreign economic policies and programs
shared_material.explanation: Both assign the Special Assistant an advisory and developmental role in international affairs.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I shall also look to you for assistance in reviewing and developing methods and programs by which the various Departments and agencies of the government may effectively contribute
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I shall look to you to provide for the anticipation of problems and issues, ensure advance preparation, analyze information ... and determine the primary responsibilities of the executive agencies
shared_material.explanation: Both use the distinctive “I shall look to you” formula to charge the appointee with reviewing or developing coordinated work across executive agencies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: You are requested to attend the meetings of the Cabinet, the National Security Council, the Council on Foreign Economic Policy, and the Operations Coordinating Board.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The achievement of such integration will be furthered by your attendance at such meetings of those organizations as you consider necessary
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude the assignment by connecting the Special Assistant to high-level councils and interagency coordinating bodies through meeting attendance.
